description: Historical full runs of every built solution notebook on 9 October 2026, with models and data already downloaded. The runs array preserves those timings, notebook hashes and hardware rather than replacing classroom benchmark evidence. Later Markdown, comments and headers changed. On 10 October the original checkpoint differed only in Week 1 export metadata; the independent follow-up then added explicit hosted-call switches to Weeks 1, 6 and 11 and repeated their full local runs. The runner skips installation and interactive cells. Current code equality and run/image evidence are in research/FOLLOWUP_2026-10-10.json.

runs.note: CPU path: two MNIST epochs and SD-Turbo for Part B.
CPU quick path: Flan-T5-small, one reasoning run per mode, short token budgets.
LoRA training ran on the CPU (GPU hidden with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES); training took 52.5 min, the recorded run in curriculum/assets/week_08/results.json took 75.9 min with the same losses.
Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct on the CPU, chosen with GENAI_VLM (the notebook's automatic CPU choice is SmolVLM-256M); GENAI_FORCE_CPU=1.
